correctness.rationale: PASS: From the generator L_theta=q d²/dtheta²+r[f(theta*)-f(theta)], stationarity yields E exp(ik(Theta-theta*))=r/(r+q k²). Thus E cos(2(Theta-phi))=A cos(2psi), Var cos(2(Theta-phi))=V_phi=[1-A²+(B-A²) cos(4psi)]/2 with A=r/(r+4q), B=r/(r+16q). The centered degree-two angular harmonic is an eigenfunction of the resetting generator of eigenvalue -(r+4q); its stationary covariance decays exactly as V_phi exp(-(r+4q)|t-s|). Conditional on the full independent angle trajectory, the projected spatial displacement is centered Gaussian with random variance 2D0t+2delta integral cos(2(Theta-phi))ds. Consequently its fourth CUMULANT, not its raw fourth moment, equals three times the random conditional-variance variance: 24 delta² V_phi [t/(r+4q)-(1-exp(-(r+4q)t))/(r+4q)²]. SymPy independently verified B-A²=8rq(2q-r)/((r+16q)(r+4q)²), yielding the sole positive crossover r=2q. At crossover, variance remains anisotropic by 4 delta t/3; strict fourth-cumulant positivity requires delta!=0 and t>0. For deterministic initial angle, stationary formula is asserted only to leading long-time order and follows from exponentially relaxing two/fourth Fourier harmonics. This is an analytical proof; symbolic checks alone do not establish stationarity or infinite-time claims.

value.rationale: PASS: The finite-time fourth-cumulant tensor is a natural first non-Gaussian observable beyond previously derived anisotropic effective diffusion. Its sharp rate r=2q is a mathematically explanatory boundary at which a genuine fourth-cumulant isotropy occurs without covariance isotropy. The distinction between cumulants, raw fourth moments and excess kurtosis is substantive and rigorously delimited. This is a motivated exact observable of an established stochastic model, not merely a reparameterized variance formula.
